coverage.summary: Applies to renting, buying, selling or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston. The page states no unit-count, building-age or owner-occupancy limits or exemptions.

evidence.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.

result.notes: I removed the summary's claim that the rule complements G.L. c. 151B, § 4(10), because no document contains that text. I set supersedes_state_rule to null because no passage addresses the rule's relationship to state law. requires_unknown_facts is false because the page applies the rule to 'any housing' in Boston, not to a subsidized or regulated subset. The page states no exemptions, so unverifiable_exemptions is empty. The underlying ordinance (Boston City Code) is not among the documents, so any owner-occupancy or small-building exemption remains unconfirmed.
